title: Prove the sharp rectangular native-fusion approximation floor (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration: the sharp relaxed error for replacing two independent rank-one Gaussian tensor targets through one rank-r child, norm-bounded rectangular adapters and a column-sparse bypass is

```text
d = 2^f, alpha = 2^(-(r-1)f/2)
min max-column error = min normalized-Frobenius error
                     = sqrt(1-h/d) max(0,1-M alpha)
```

Here r>=2, the adapter maximum-column-sum/maximum-row-sum norm product is at most M, and the bypass has at most h nonzeros per column. Every column obeys the lower bound. A two-spectator projected construction attains both minima simultaneously in the relaxation.

For fixed M and sublinear bypass support, the error tends to one. At f=8, r=2 and M=1, error at most 1/2 requires at least 184 bypass entries per 256-entry target column. The attainer expands banks by 2^((r-1)f), so this is an obstruction and exact relaxed optimum, not an affordable physical fusion or new kappa.

## Evidence

- Before: ToikY [#7166](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7166) supplies the exact rectangular amplitude obstruction and projected tensor control. This contribution adds the positive approximation floor, its sharp simultaneous attainer and the exact sparse-bypass/error tradeoff.
- After: the standalone Gaussian-rational checker passes 140 attaining constructions covering 1,300 columns, 40 general mixed-lane adapter cases covering 320 columns, 8,784 independently constructed tensor entries, three semantic controls, four capacity rejections and all 257 supports for the threshold example.
- CPython 3.12.15 normal and optimized warning-strict direct checks passed in 0.22 and 0.23 seconds, individually below their 120-second registered limits. Both registered commands passed. Generated hash-bound receipts agree byte for byte.
- Source compilation, metadata/provenance pins, exact committed bytes, executable modes, declared source ancestry, official export integrity and read-only Git-free normal/optimized exported replays passed. Receipt overwrite is rejected without changing its bytes.
- No predecessor scientific verifier, native census or invoice was replayed as this contribution.

From the repository root, the exact local reproduction commands are:


Any CPython 3.12 interpreter may replace the local path. The direct marker is `PASS_SHARP_APPROXIMATE_NATIVE_FUSION`; the runner reports `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

## Limitations and credit

The universal quantifiers rest on PROOF.md. The error metrics are the induced l1-to-l2 norm and normalized Frobenius norm; spectral-norm optimality is unclaimed. The model permits complex width-dependent singular rectangular adapters, arbitrary finite spectator multiplicity, zero preparation, output projection and an otherwise unpriced sparse bypass. Physical bank stock, source delivery, routing, precision, ownership return, dirty restoration, tape costs and a favorable complete recursive invoice remain separate obligations. The equality construction uses exponentially expanded banks. No selected cold replay, physical caller, Lean or Docker replay, supplier admission or complete multiplication theorem is supplied. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

The proof and checker were produced by Nick Petalas. Credit ToikY #7166 for the rectangular norm model and projection, Clear1nsight #4932/#4045/#3989 for related scoped fusion boundaries, and zxv, Clear1nsight #7161, Rohan Arun #7113 and the retained Gaussian native lineage. The source proof is cited at exact head `6efb5d028b3212fba68edfb725608413622d6ab6`; no predecessor code or external runtime input is used.

Canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8, selected #7000. The coverage-law-change card changes to a local approximate-interface obstruction. Only this six-file package is added. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19541721).

## Open next questions

- Determine the spectral-norm optimum under the same constraints. Start with f=1, h=1 and different bypass support patterns; correlated residual columns are the missing step.
- Determine attainable error with charged bank expansion strictly below two. Start with an exact physical source/consumer layout and charge its stock, bypass, restoration and routing.

## Related open work

This package restricts column support and determines maximum-column and normalized-Frobenius error. The different bypass constraint leaves the present spectral-norm optimum open; no common numerical optimum is compared.

The completion refresh checked this account's open PRs created since the CLAIM. #7256 is the newly related result; the other new submissions study different objects or quantities. No extra scientific computation checked their results.

- [#7166](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7166) is the direct exact-amplitude predecessor; this adds the sharp approximate endpoint law without recounting its native stock.

- [#7246](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7246) studies finite monomial decoders on #7244; this permits arbitrary rectangular coefficients under induced-norm bounds.
- [#7144](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7144) excludes fixed-caller diagonal body retiming; this does not change or test that scalar chronology.
- [#7003](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7003) supplies exact paid MOVE fusions by relocating contacts; the approximate-adapter obstruction does not exclude those changed words.
- [#7161](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7161) and [#7244](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7244) propose complete paid-word improvements. This package computes no competing kappa or invoice and changes neither word.

These relations compare published contracts only. No additional computation checked another contribution's numbers.
